newsitem.title: DENMARK: Pedersen not raising Phoenix bid.
newsitem.headline: Pedersen not raising Phoenix bid.

text.p: Danish provincial building contractor Marius Pedersen said on Thursday it was not raising its bid for local roadbuilder Phoenix.

"The board of Marius Pedersen has decided after thorough deliberation that the bid it has put in for shares in Phoenix Contractors is its final offer," Pedersen said in a statement sent to Copenhagen Stock Exchange.

The highest bid at present is from Norway's Rieber & Son offering 725 crowns per A-share and 650 crowns each for the most-traded C-share, compared to Pedersen's offer of 710 crowns per A-share and 625 crowns per C-share.
Phoenix shareholders assemble on Friday for an extraordinary meeting where they are to chose their favourite suitor. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
